candidates.title: Monitor newsroom feeds for a digest

demandEvidence.chore: Monitor selected newsroom pages and feeds, then collect new items into a reviewable digest.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: building a fully automated news site monitoring different newsrooms, desks, feeds etc on the web.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a few operator-supplied feed examples, but no supplied reference documents feed monitoring or digest creation.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: communications researchers might pay for a monitoring digest; this launch post establishes no customer, repeat need or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can compare supplied sample headlines and format a digest; live source coverage and freshness remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could group supplied updates, but a person must choose sources and check omissions or misleading matches.

evidence.reason: The author states an interest in a fully automated news site monitoring newsrooms and feeds, but gives no detailed workflow or buyer evidence.

candidates.reason: A narrow sample-feed digest is assessable, but the sole launch excerpt does not establish a repeated professional chore or implementation support; provisional mean 4.8 is below 6.

candidates.title: Send email after an app trigger

demandEvidence.chore: Send an email through a selected provider when an event occurs in another app.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want a Make scenario to send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app.

ease.reason: A beginner can mock one sample event and test message, but no supplied reference supports provider setup or delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent automation consultants might pay for setup help; the request establishes no buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can use a sample trigger and test inbox; live SMTP configuration and delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A configured trigger might repeat sending, but a person must authorize credentials, verify delivery and handle failures.

evidence.reason: The request names provider email after another app trigger, but gives no volume, constraints or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: This concrete request was already assessed as a below-threshold trigger-to-email experiment in recent decisions; no new implementation evidence changes that assessment.

candidates.title: Enrich business leads from directories

demandEvidence.chore: Collect directory entries and enrich business leads with information from legal notice pages.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I built an end-to-end n8n pipeline for DACH/German B2B lead enrichment that chains German directory scraping with an automated § 5 DDG Impressum extractor .

ease.reason: A synthetic business-only sample could test field formatting, but no supplied reference supports scraping or extraction and real records may identify people.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: B2B research firms might pay for lead preparation; this free workflow post establishes no paying buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test could format fictional company records, but replicating scraping or extracting personal data needs authorization and privacy review.

autonomy.reason: A mock could structure approved sample fields; a person must verify source permission, minimize data and check each result.

evidence.reason: The post describes a directory-to-lead-enrichment pipeline, but establishes neither repeated unmet demand nor authorized data use.

candidates.reason: The described workflow involves scraping directory and legal-notice data, potentially including personal details; only a fictional business-only mock is supportable, and its provisional mean 4.2 is below threshold.

candidates.title: Check Cloudflare R2 signer settings

demandEvidence.chore: Find the officially supported signer configuration for Cloudflare R2 requests.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: What is the officially supported signer configuration for Cloudflare R2 with service = “s3”?

ease.reason: A beginner could build a checklist from operator-supplied settings, but no reference documents Cloudflare R2 signing or Make configuration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: automation consultants might pay for configuration help, but this one request establishes no recurring buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could compare supplied settings with a manually verified checklist; correct signer requirements and live access remain unknown.

autonomy.reason: A form could flag missing fields, but a person must verify current provider requirements and test the signed request; no reference supports automation.

evidence.reason: The post directly asks for an officially supported signer configuration for R2 with service s3, but gives no answer or repeated-work evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow proposed checklist that flags missing operator-supplied signer settings; the provisional mean is 18/5 = 3.6, below 6. No supplied implementation reference or verified configuration supports a more capable experiment.

rejected.title: Build an automated newsroom monitoring site
rejected.reason: Assessed a sample-feed digest experiment; provisional mean 4.8 is below 6. The launch excerpt gives no recurring buyer need or implementation evidence.

rejected.title: Find a first automation client
rejected.reason: The post says only that the author wants to build skills and earn income; it identifies no specific existing chore, so a task, payer, or experiment would have to be invented.

rejected.title: Send triggered email through Make
rejected.reason: Assessed the concrete trigger-to-email mock (mean 4.6). This repeats the same product identity and workflow as recent rejection decisions; no new evidence supports changing the prior conclusion.

rejected.title: Enrich B2B leads from directories
rejected.reason: A fictional business-only mock is assessable but below threshold (mean 4.2); the described scraping and legal-notice extraction may involve personal data, with no evidence of authorized collection or privacy controls.

rejected.title: Troubleshoot Cloudflare R2 signer settings
rejected.reason: The concrete configuration request was assessed as a narrow operator-input checklist (provisional mean 3.6), below the threshold. No supplied implementation reference or verified signer guidance supports an automated configuration answer; a person must verify official requirements and test settings.

steps.message: Repair reassessed the one named omitted task with five provisional scores. Its narrow checklist experiment is below threshold; retained prior candidate decisions and exclusions unchanged, with no proposed posts.
